prerequisites: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY must be present in the environment.
The server should be operating against Stripe test mode, and get_stripe_account_info should report account_id acct_1Tnld5HooSxt57lc.
No disposable PaymentIntent fixture and no working observer were supplied; write-path CALL_ONCE steps therefore use approval-gated or safe-fail inputs only.

rationale_evidence.detail: Rank 1 among ambiguous candidates: selected the deterministic producer-consumer edge from stripe_api_search.openapi_spec_version to send_stripe_mcp_feedback.context because the producer field is required output and can safely ground feedback context without introducing a mutation dependency.

Rank 2 among ambiguous candidates: selected the deterministic producer-consumer edge from send_stripe_mcp_feedback.message to stripe_implementation_planner.message because the feedback tool always returns a required message field and planner.message accepts arbitrary text.

parameters.question: What Stripe test-mode constraints apply to refunding a PaymentIntent, and what PaymentIntent ID format is expected?

stop_conditions: Stop if get_stripe_account_info reports an account_id other than acct_1Tnld5HooSxt57lc.
Stop if any write-path CALL_ONCE step returns a human-approval URL; do not perform a second-stage approval_token call in this plan.
Stop if any step appears to target live-mode or non-disposable resources.
Stop if a mutation unexpectedly succeeds, because no working observer or teardown-backed disposable scope was established.
